_meta.description: SEO/GEO topic bank for the Nuvin anxiety-relief blog. Author once in English, localize-translate to French. Encodes the deep-research brief: honest evidence footing per technique, per-topic safety flags, and staged publishing.

generation_rules.voice: Calm, direct, permission-giving. Technique above the fold, minimal intro (readers are anxious NOW). Coach ONE technique deeply rather than listing many.
generation_rules.core_differentiator: Hyper-situational, in-the-moment 'do this right now' coaching backed by Nuvin's offline instant-relief product. Own the specific moment (panic at work, 3am, highway driving), not generic listicles.
honesty_guardrails: Cite real evidence where it exists (Stanford/Balban 2023 RCT for breathing/physiological sigh; Fincham 2023 meta-analysis; Manzoni 2008 for PMR; Ensari 2015 for single-bout exercise).

Be honest where evidence is weak: grounding is clinically endorsed but under-tested standalone; shake/stretch is only preliminarily evidenced, NEVER claim 'trauma release', frame as movement/tension-release.
Quote the hype-vs-evidence caution from breathwork research; do not oversell.
Nuvin is a self-help tool for everyday, situational anxiety. NOT a medical device, diagnosis, therapy, or crisis service.
generation_rules.citations: Prefer primary sources with DOIs. Verify Stanford RCT N (111-114) and 2026 PMR effect size against full text before citing exact figures.
generation_rules.seo_structure: TL;DR / direct answer first, question-format H2s, FAQPage schema from the topic's faq array, inverted pyramid, internal links to related topics and always to the safety hub (when-to-see-a-professional).

crisis_disclaimer_levels.standard: The baked-in per-language CrisisDisclaimer component (US 988 / France 3114) at the article foot.
crisis_disclaimer_levels.elevated: Standard disclaimer PLUS an in-body caution specific to the topic (e.g., rule out medical causes, pull over when driving, recurrent symptoms warrant a professional).
crisis_disclaimer_levels.strict: Health-anxiety editorial rules: NO symptom reassurance, NO diagnostic symptom lists, always route to professional support. Reassurance-seeking is a documented maintaining factor.

safety.out_of_scope: Crisis triage, self-harm counseling, diagnosis, medication advice. These are deliberately excluded.

localization.tone_brief_fr: France is more skeptical of American positive-thinking wellness. Be more evidence-forward, understated, less hype. Adapt crisis resources to France (3114 national suicide prevention line, 15 SAMU, 112 EU emergency), NOT US 988. Adapt examples and idioms, keep every citation and caveat intact.

staging.stage_1: Launch (first ~60 days): own urgent situational moments. Clusters 1, 2, 3 + the safety hub (when-to-see-a-professional) FIRST.
staging.stage_2: 60-150 days: credibility layer (Cluster 5 science explainers) + Cluster 4 (driving/flying/social, where offline is a differentiator).
staging.stage_3: 150+ days: worry-cycle (Cluster 6, strict editorial) + lifestyle (Cluster 7) + meta/trust (Cluster 8).
